text:
maya: Opening a small PR to refresh the Quickstart hello-world guide. Plan: clarify auth, add a curl example, include a tiny Vercel ephemeral-token serverless snippet, and update SDK examples to v8 client usage. Need reviewers.
ryan: Please split into commits: docs+auth, SDK snippet changes, link fixes. Easier to review.
nora: Add a minimal curl example under "Test locally" so folks can rule out SDK/network issues.
maya: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4950 (WIP). Curl I'll add like:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'
```
selma: Also remind Docker users to EXPOSE 3000 and show `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 3000:3000 my-hello`.
ryan: I'll handle the SDK snippet conversion to Client pattern. Add a note about pinning model versions to avoid silent regressions.
maya: Adding `model: \"redwood/gpt-small:2025-01-01\"` in examples and a short note on updating.
nora: Tiny nit: keep env var name standardized as REDWOOD_API_KEY across all samples.
maya: Affirmed.
selma: For the Vercel example, call it an "ephemeral token" and caution about caching it only per invocation to avoid leakage.
maya: Vercel sample added and wording updated. Small serverless handler snippet included.
docbot: deploy-bot: preview build queued for PR 4950 (ETA ~6m).
ryan: Add local smoke test steps: `npm ci && npm run start`, then the curl. Mention clearing KV cache if outputs look stale.
maya: Done. Fixed broken deploy link to /docs/deploy/quickstart. Waiting for preview then will merge if green.
docbot: deploy-bot: preview for PR 4950 finished (status: success) - https://deploy-preview-4950--docs.redwood.ai
maya: Preview looks good, merging after CI passes. Follow-up: docs#224 migrate remaining examples to client v8 in next sprint.
ryan: Assign me for the SDK batch.
ora: LGTM from newbie UX perspective. Short and scannable.
maya: Thanks all :tada: Closing thread.
